description: This file defines API routes for managing 'notes' in a FastAPI application, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes using sqlmodel for database interactions.

methods.name: NoteRead create_note(payload: NoteCreate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Creates a new note, adds it to the session, commits, refreshes, and returns the created note as a NoteRead model.

methods.name: NotesListResponse list_notes( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for title or content"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Max items to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of items to skip"), session: Session = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search query 'q', supports pagination with 'limit' and 'offset', returns a NotesListResponse.

methods.name: NoteRead get_note(note_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID, raises HTTP 404 if not found, returns as NoteRead.

methods.name: NoteRead update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Updates an existing note’s title and/or content if provided, sets updated_at timestamp, commits, and returns the updated note.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, raises HTTP 404 if not found, returns no content.
